name: David Moellenkamp
headline: Director of Product Management at Shopify

experiences.description: Building developer tooling and experiences for Shopify partners.
Helping build the future of commerce.

As Senior Director of Technical Product Management I lead a team of Product Owners responsible for ensuring our product meets the demanding needs of our Enterprise customers. These solutions products include BlackBerry Enterprise Server, BlackBerry Business Cloud Services for Microsoft Office 365, BlackBerry Enterprise Service 10 and BES12.

Managed a team of 30+ highly technical development support analysts tasked with debugging the most complex customer support issues. Communicated problem status updates to VP and executive stakeholders and managed development interactions with our Enterprise customers.

Other key responsibilities:

 • Managed requirements and contents of maintenance releases for BlackBerry Enterprise Server 
 •  Worked with Customer Support Operations to drive issues to closure and advocate on behalf of customers to various development teams.
 • Create and deliver technical presentations to customers of small, medium and large audience sizes
